## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or parity requirement if applicable.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results, including skipped tests or work still unverified. For UI changes, include the native flow exercised; for conversion changes, describe the fixture and output inspection.

## Limits

Record material fidelity, compatibility, performance or dependency/license limits introduced or left unresolved. Remove this section if there are none relevant to the change.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change preserves source inputs, cancellation, output collision handling and the shared worker limit where applicable.
- [ ] New dependencies or assets include their source, license and redistribution requirements, or none were added.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots and logs contain no credentials, personal files or private account/path details.
- [ ] Relevant checks and any unverified native behavior are recorded above.
